# Pure artifact preset reducers

Source commit: `3c5b227649371507ddc4eb46ac5133afe6db1cab` from
https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode.

- `apply.ts` is the original `packages/ui/src/app-shell/workflow-artifacts/presets/apply.ts`.
  Only its two import specifiers change to local `./field.js` and `./spec.js`.
- `spec.ts` is the original sibling file, byte-for-byte unchanged.
- `field.ts` is the verbatim `readWorkflowArtifactField` function and its comment
  extracted from `packages/shared/src/zcode-protocol-v4/workflow-artifacts.ts`.
  The enclosing module's protocol schemas require Zod; those unrelated schemas are
  not included. The pure function has no imports.
- `index.js` is generated by esbuild from those three files. It has no React,
  application service, TypeScript compiler or protocol-schema dependency.

Run `node vendor/zcode/ui-presets/build.mjs` to rebuild, then
`node vendor/zcode/ui-presets/selfcheck.mjs` for assertion checks covering table
upserts, per-field latest metrics, board card moves, log chart filtering and baseline,
and nested field paths.

The original Apache-2.0 license and notices are retained in the parent directory.
These source and generated files retain that upstream license; the plugin's MIT
license does not relicense them.
